notes.title: Development Update: New Village Buildings
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, commanders![/h3][p][/p][p]We’ve finished working on the buildings for the small villages of East Prussia and they’ll be part of the upcoming demo!

We’re excited to share some new GIFs where you can see each building going through four stages of destruction. There are three main types of buildings:
[/p][h3]Small rural houses[/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/ee93386a4b59ce9f7564f6c8adcec5374cd3b98b.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/4e4fa9f96c81c53a5259d7328dd8f4bacd5f605f.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/31d14ca21da771061c347cc08e9b88acb9290808.gif"][/img]
[/p][h3]Farm buildings[/h3][p]Cow barns, sheds, and other structures[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/4867ccdaddc7cc4f672d5097ed01f0fd9772de64.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/2e9979e49f3acc6c6a50cd2a05688d71afa51314.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/bb4d2e3c16197cce3a486bdecf4d2b08aedad055.gif"][/img]
[/p][h3]Old buildings[/h3][p]Old barns and storage buildings that look worn and weathered

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/860d880716c0f3095b8c97ea25a704aa9cf9f1a4.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/2d7560965de47160381077513124775fa2b89c40.gif"][/img]


We’ve also added more variety to the field assets: now you’ll see different types of crops growing, such as sunflowers, wheat, and more

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/fde2417925e3a80441d0e6c9b03b51109f7ddbf4.png"][/img]


Thank you for your continued support!

— The Panzer Strike Team[/p]

notes.title: Development Update: Spring Progress and New Content
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, commanders![/h3]

We’re excited to share our biggest development update yet for Panzer Strike. This spring, we've added a huge amount of new content, including:

[h3]New Environment Assets[/h3]

[b]A wide range of residential and agricultural buildings from East Prussia and various small environmental objects and vegetation[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/30edd5f395bfa41ef59aba15f57a4c3baa23c520.gif[/img]

[b]Cliffs​[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/2e27dad8b3ebc9d60179346a9d72858faf62aaea.gif[/img]

[h3]New Artillery[/h3]

[b]Pak-38[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/e833d9c73bc50b1110f4f8e1c202d46a652b38d2.gif[/img]

[b]Pak-40[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/e0b42e5c3f7651bcf20b58b99a0bc19a0029aacc.gif[/img]

[b]ZIS-2[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/4a5dc5f2c39f82e15b991d94d39bacd4346b7365.gif[/img]

[b]ZIS-3[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/fff6b8f19605cb8530094dfd60a73f9913440381.gif[/img]

[h3]New Vehicles[/h3]

[b]Opel Blitz[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/9e4c635470b27c33ae6bf364a8999a47809fe33d.gif[/img]

[b]ZIS-5[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/93080a55730533eb9fab49163894f62cff5947fe.gif[/img]

[b]Hetzer[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/880f5bedd714ccf0a188cdd4f3b1cf1087b7846c.gif[/img]

[b]IS-2[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/4c0d7d62b39dc043e09fb03142ffa0c90f2d8b42.gif[/img]

[b]T-34 model 1943[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/795a3d1853078dbf4d43f5b157387cd6831ba9be.gif[/img]

[h3]New Visual Effects[/h3]

[b]Tracer effects[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/bec758e1d84ba09f3cf8e8c89043b7f43ae31697.gif[/img]

[h3]New Infantry Units[/h3]

[b]German gunner[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/698070a7947a59696ee1198534908aed2fe91b7f.gif[/img]

[b]Soviet crew[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/1bf3a364aa662fa42edbb2e29f5aa7de7b515ce6.gif[/img]

We’ve also been working hard on gameplay mechanics and added a lot of new features, including:

[b]Vehicle crews can now operate vehicles[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/cd6aa03241c43eb6ce56fad020a550a64b4fb49d.gif[/img]

[b]Crews driving trucks can transport infantry in the cargo area and tow artillery[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/f0a3143292802b2356c8c60ae65e1f94101db806.gif[/img]

[b]Infantry can capture buildings[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/30edd5f395bfa41ef59aba15f57a4c3baa23c520.gif[/img]

[b]Crews can peek out of hatches to improve visibility​[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/7864b93fbebad73510467ac2b4b98053d16de6e2.gif[/img]

Additionally, we've added many more houses and environmental objects. We'll share more about these in our next update. Stay tuned!

Currently, we're actively working on the demo version: fixing bugs, balancing gameplay, designing maps, and scripting missions. We're in the final stages and plan to release it soon

Thank you for your continued support!

— The Panzer Strike Team

notes.title: Development Update: New Year’s Edition
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, commanders![/h3]

As we complete our first full year of developing our game, we couldn’t be happier to see the growing interest from all of you! In these final days leading up to the New Year, we wanted to share some exciting updates we’ve been working on:

[h3]New Vehicles Added:[/h3]

[b]Ferdinand[/b]

[b]BA-64[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/7af0582bc5962ead7938942f5abf6b90d1ae6f5d.gif[/img]

[b]ISU-152[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/3c0cd7f5f6db45dac829952f23fe9dead130bcbf.gif[/img]

[b]SU-85[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/3cf16f457f38d2957e09e31a7be14ca8f39d074e.gif[/img]

[h3]Vehicle Fire Animation:[/h3]
We’ve implemented realistic fire animations for destroyed vehicles, adding another layer of intensity to your battles

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/d7b1f3260f7ab6e78d19d684b79111e159b52fd2.gif[/img]

Additionally, we continue to work diligently on preparing a demo version of the game. Stay tuned for more details soon

Lastly, we’d like to wish everyone a very happy New Year! May it bring you joy, prosperity, and countless memorable moments!

notes.title: Development Update: First Infantry Units Added to the Build
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, commanders![/h2]

We’re excited to share a quick update! Our first infantry unit has been tested and is now fully functional in the build.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/3e9629b7d6f8501eddecf1f7331083180ad11b49.gif[/img]

Along with the tests, we’ve also added a running animation to bring the unit to life on the battlefield

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275656/957ab7d571f37b69790b8f29b5ca878322d92faa.gif[/img]

You can check out the full HD video showcasing the infantry unit in action!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7hOmPr2cFIc


We’ll continue improving and adding more animations soon, so keep an eye out for further updates. Thanks for your continued support as we work toward making the game even better!

— The Panzer Strike Team
